pairs.description: Silymarin in milk thistle inhibits CYP2C9 and may increase losartan concentrations while decreasing its active carboxylic acid metabolite.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP2C9-mediated metabolic oxidation of losartan to its active EXP3174 metabolite.

pairs.description: Milk thistle extract inhibits intestinal glucuronidation enzymes, potentially increasing the oral bioavailability of raloxifene.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of UDP-glucuronosyltransferase UGT1A1 and UGT1A9 in the intestinal mucosa by silybin.

pairs.description: Silymarin may inhibit CYP2C9 metabolism of S-warfarin, leading to modest increases in prothrombin time and bleeding susceptibility.
pairs.mechanism: Competitive inhibition of cytochrome P450 2C9-mediated hepatic clearance of active S-warfarin.
